// This file is compiled only through the additive composition-test overlay.
package sqlite

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/kandev/kandev/internal/agentctl/types/streams"
	"github.com/kandev/kandev/internal/task/models"
	"github.com/kandev/kandev/internal/task/ownanswer"
)

// SyntheticApprovalRepository injects only a synthetic binding into the same
// transaction workers. Production exported selectors remain untouched.
type SyntheticApprovalRepository struct {
	*Repository
	Binding ownanswer.OwnAnswerBinding
}

func (r *SyntheticApprovalRepository) CreateApprovalLinkGrant(ctx context.Context, req ownanswer.ApprovalLinkRequest) (*ownanswer.ApprovalLinkGrant, error) {
	if req.OwnAnswerBinding != r.Binding {
		return nil, errApprovalLink
	}
	return r.createApprovalLinkGrant(ctx, req)
}

func (r *SyntheticApprovalRepository) ConsumeApprovalLinkGrant(ctx context.Context, b ownanswer.OwnAnswerBinding, id, op, incarnation string) ([]*models.Message, bool, error) {
	e, ok := streams.MCPExecutionContextFromContext(ctx)
	if b != r.Binding || !ok || e.TaskID != b.TaskID || e.SessionID != b.SessionID || e.ExecutionID == "" {
		return nil, false, errApprovalLink
	}
	return r.consumeApprovalLinkGrant(ctx, b, id, op, incarnation)
}
